summary: FD_TC_102_No Determination | OAL Data Not Available | 14 Days | APPR
title: No Determination | OAL Data Not Available | 14 Days | APPR
description:
Multi-leg international journey with an AC-operated leg AND an OAL-operated leg (British Airways). AC's own leg data is complete, but the OAL leg data has NOT been received through OAG (Official Airline Guide) data feeds within the 14-day window. Without OAL timing data, DDS cannot determine: (1) actual arrival at the final destination (EDI), (2) whether the delay was caused by AC's leg or the OAL leg, (3) correct MSL identification across carriers. The case is routed for manual handling. Different from TC_072 (AC's own data missing) � here AC's data is fine but the PARTNER airline's data is unavailable from the external feed.

Prerequisites:
PNR: TC056 � single passenger (Adult). Journey: 2 legs: Leg 1 AC 848 YUL?LHR (AC operated � data AVAILABLE); Leg 2 BA 1234 LHR?EDI (British Airways operated � data NOT AVAILABLE). Flight date: April 28, 2026. AC leg data: Complete (departure, arrival, codes � all available). OAL leg data: NOT RECEIVED from OAG feeds within 14-day window. Final destination: EDI (Edinburgh). Actual arrival at EDI: UNKNOWN (depends on OAL data). 14-day retry: EXHAUSTED. Regime: APPR (Canada departure); EU potentially applicable (LHR connection).
